title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode7 The First Step

rows.Line: Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I can still feel the guitar strings under my fingers.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(We met Miku, and played a song together.
It wasn't a dream.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We were there all together, Saki, Honami, Shiho and I, and we played.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It was fun.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We used to be a tight group, always together. Saki would come up with ideas for what we could do. Whenever Shiho got too wrapped up in things, Honami would always be there to intervene.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It's been a while since we've all done something together, but things were just the way they used to be.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Maybe if we got the band back together, like Saki said...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Things between us could go back to how they used to be...
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: H-Hello, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hi.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Do you remember what happened yesterday?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um, yeah.
It was so bizarre... I was so surprised.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I can't explain it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Neither can I...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, you still play drums?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, yes. I haven't played for about half a year though, so I've gotten rusty.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That Untitled song appeared on my phone out of nowhere.
You have it too?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I don't know how it got there.
Strange how it happened to both of us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Miku called that world a place made from our feelings.
Sounds like nonsense, but what if it's true?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Do you have strong feelings, too? The same kind of feelings as Ichika and Saki?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: M-Me?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Honami! Let's go buy lunch!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sorry, I've got to go.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: Yikes, Hinomori's glaring at us. Did she say something mean to you, Honami? Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm fine... It wasn't anything like that...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: She's really scary. Definitely in the no-friends zone.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah. Did you hear that she hangs out at some sketchy dive?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't think that's true. She just has a part-time job at a live house.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
Are you guys friends?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um...

You act chummy with just about anyone.
Whose side are you on?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I just heard about it from someone else.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line:
Anyway, live houses are sketchy, right?
I think they're kinda scary...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Shiho isn't that kind of person...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Pathetic.
My, if it isn't my sweet Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What are you doing in the first years' hallway?
Everyone's staring already.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Look, it's Shizuku Hinomori! Wow!
Isn't she stunning?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm just passing by on my way to see a friend.
Hold on...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is something wrong? You're even more sullen than usual.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm fine. I told you not to talk to me at school, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Shii...
You don't look okay to me...
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yesterday was amaaazing! It's hard to believe,
but it wasn't a dream, right? Right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, look! I have Untitled on my phone too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho and Hona must have it too, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I think so.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's so weird that the same track appeared on our phones, but it's kind of nice. It's like we have a special connection!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, do you think it's got something to do with what Miku said about us having shared feelings?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If Shiho and Hona share strong feelings with us, then doesn't that mean...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But wait a minute, they flat out rejected my offer to get the band back together, so maybe I'm wrong about this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's a real shame, though, because it would be so awesome to have a band. It might help us become close again too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi? Your eyes are so serious all of a sudden. What is it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, I was just thinking...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why don't WE start a band? Just the two of us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What, you want to? For real?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right. Two people isn't really a band...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, no, it'll be fine! I'm so happy! Thank you for this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And thinking long-term, Hona and Shiho may decide to join us at some point when they see how much fun we're having!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, maybe.
Let's try it and see how far we can take it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It may be difficult to bring us all back together.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I want to do this for Saki. If she's not giving up, I'm sticking with her.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'll do everything I can!)
